rulings.Rulings: Continued to 11/4/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) Who is the petitioner? Item 2 shows Yoshihiro Tanaka as the petitioner, but the pleading is signed and verified by Ryosuke Togi. (2) Persons and their nominees are entitled to appointment as administrator with the will annexed in the same order of priority as for appointment of an administrator. [Prob. C. Sect. 8441(a).] (3) The public administrator has priority before any other person. [Prob. C. Sect. 8461.] (4) No one appears to have standing to nominate. [Prob. C. Sect. 8402(a)(4).] (5) A copy of the lost will does not appear to have been filed. The public administrator must decline to serve before any other person can be appointed. Courtesy copies of any papers filed to address these issues must be received by the assigned examiner by no later than 10/21/26. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B. (No courtesy copies of the amended petition and related papers were received by the assigned examiner by the 8/31/26 deadline.)

rulings.Rulings: Hearing. Appearance required. The Court to determine how best to proceed. The petition does not identify who the professional fiduciary would be, if the Court declines to appoint Trenton Lowe as successor co-trustee or removes Kingman Zhi Zhen as co-trustee or suspends Kingman Zhi Zhen and Gary Gin as successor co-trustees. Trenton Lowe is not named as a successor trustee or co-trustee in any of the trust instruments. The beneficiaries who have consented to his petition and to his appointment as a successor co-trustee have not waived bond for him. Regardless of the language about bond in the trust instrument, the issue of bond was not addressed in the petition. Please have the CASE NUMBER and the CASE NAME ready for the clerk. Parties appearing must check in for the hearing using their FULL NAME. Counsel and parties may appear in person or remotely through Zoom or CourtCall. Please review LRSF 14.1 D. for information on remote appearances. For Zoom appearance: meeting ID is 160 225 4765 and password is 514879. For audio-only telephone appearance via Zoom, call 1-669-254-5252 and follow the prompts, using the meeting ID and password above. Counsel and parties may appear by audio-only telephone through CourtCall by calling 1-888-882-6878.
